info.title: Yamlet CLI — run Yamlet API collections headlessly.
info.description: Yamlet CLI — run Yamlet API collections headlessly (e.g. in CI). Loads a workspace, sends every request in order, evaluates pm.test assertions, and exits non-zero on failure.

options.name: --env
options.description:
Environment YAML to apply (file path, or a loaded environment
name). Omit to run with globals only.

options.name: --globals
options.description: Override the workspace globals with this YAML file.

options.name: --bail
options.description: Stop after the first failing request.

options.name: --no-color
options.description: Disable ANSI colors (also honors the NO_COLOR env var).

options.name: --version
options.description:
Show the CLI version.
Exit code:
0 if every request returned 2xx/3xx and every pm.test passed; 1 otherwise.

arguments.name: WORKSPACE
arguments.description:
Path to a Yamlet workspace (a folder containing collections/ and
environments/, or its parent — same as opening it in the app).
